'''Romar Kek''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] commanding officer of the [[Defiant Core]] base on [[Innton II]] after the base was able to support a small fleet of [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and [[Speeder truck/Legends|speeder trucks]]. Kek was an older [[Human/Legends|Human]] who had a strict command style, but was able to improvise with unusual assets or situations. Before his service in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Kek had served in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems']] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|navy]] as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] on the [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] ''[[Vanguard Flare]]''. The ship was destroyed during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. Romar Kek escaped to another ship and made it back to the Confederacy. During his service within the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Kek was one of the early developers of the [[Great Temple|base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Kek was promoted to [[General/Legends|general]] after the Defiant Core base received its complement of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighters]].<ref name="SoR" />
